miescher-isolates-nuclein.description: A dark, moody oil-style still life in a stone vaulted room. Centre: a clear glass conical flask holding a liquid with white sediment at its base. Right: a polished brass compound microscope on a worn wooden bench, with a small porcelain dish and glass jars nearby. Left foreground: a crumpled cloth in green and cream with reddish-brown stains, and a faint red mark on the table edge. A lit oil lamp sits at the far left. No visible text, frame or people.

flemming-chromosomes-mitosis.description: An oil-painted still life in dark brown tones. A brass compound microscope stands on the left, with a lit candle behind it at centre. On the right an open notebook shows a pen-and-ink drawing of a dividing cell, with dark threadlike bundles pulling toward two poles, and faint handwriting-like scribbles on the pages. A fountain pen rests across the page, with an inkwell and a glass dish in the foreground. Shelves and old books fill the dim background. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

mendel-work-rediscovered.description: A man with dark hair in a long dark coat leans over an open book on a cluttered wooden desk, his hand resting on the page. Potted pea plants with pods line a window sill, and the view outside shows a brick arch and greenery. Magnifying glasses, loose handwritten papers, a sprig of pea plant, bottles and stacked old books fill the room. Warm, dim, painterly light, with no visible frame or border.

chromosome-theory-inheritance.description: A dark oil painting of an oil lamp on a wooden desk between two brass microscopes. One slide holds a grasshopper, the other small round objects. A sheet of paper in front has hand-drawn chromosome sketches with arrows. Bottles and books sit in the background. No letters, frame or border. It looks early 1900s.

johannsen-coins-gene.description: A dim, warm-lit workshop painting. An older man in a dark coat examines seeds with a magnifying glass in one hand while pinching a bean with the other. Many shallow bowls of beans and seeds fill a wooden table, with an open notebook, fountain pen and a loose lens beside it. Glass jars, a lantern and laboratory glassware sit on shelves behind. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame.

morgan-fruit-fly-linkage.description: A painterly, dark-toned laboratory scene. A large glass bottle in the centre is crowded with small fruit flies and has a yellow-brown food mass at its base. A hand holds a brass magnifying glass over the bottle, and the lens shows a fly with two others nearby. Behind it are wooden shelves of smaller bottles with cotton plugs, retort stands and glassware in warm lamplight. A notebook with scribbled pages and a screwdriver lie on the bench at the bottom. No legible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

sturtevant-first-genetic-map.description: A man in a grey work shirt, seen from behind, sits at a wooden desk under a green-shaded brass lamp. He writes with a pen on a cream sheet that has a row of small dots joined by a line. Glass bottles holding specimens, an open notebook with scribbled handwriting, an ink bottle, a magnifying glass and a wooden crate sit around him in a dim, warm, oil-painted room.

muller-xray-mutations.description: A painted laboratory bench scene. A glowing glass vacuum tube on a retort stand dominates the upper centre, with a small corked vial of fruit flies at lower left and a wooden rack of six test tubes holding flies at lower right. Other glassware and copper wires fill the dark background. The style is a dark oil painting, with no visible text, frame or gore.

griffith-transforming-principle.description: A painterly, dark laboratory bench scene. Two glass petri dishes sit in the foreground: the left one holds smooth, glossy, rounded colonies in amber liquid, the right one holds rough, grainy clumps. On the right, a grey mouse sits in a wire mesh cage, beside a syringe and a rack holding a test tube of amber liquid. Glass flasks on retort stands and bottles line the dim background, with wisps of steam or smoke rising through the middle. No visible text, no frame, no people, no blood.

mcclintock-crossing-over.description: A dark, oil-painted still life. An old brass and black microscope stands on a wooden table, with dried ears of multicolored maize (red, yellow, purple kernels) and dry husks beside it. In the foreground an open book with pale pages shows two pencil or ink drawings of rod-shaped chromosome-like forms, one with a knob and a crossing point where they seem to exchange segments. Background has old leather books, glass bottles and a pressed-plant specimen box. No frame or border is visible, and there is no legible text.

one-gene-one-enzyme.description: An oil-style painting on a dark background. A wooden rack holds a row of six glass test tubes, each plugged with fluffy white cotton, and several tubes contain pinkish-orange and grey fuzzy growths over a pale medium. In front stand amber glass bottles with blank paper labels, a clear glass bottle, a glass beaker, a porcelain dish, a flask of yellow liquid, and dried leaves and a glass tube on a worn wooden bench. No legible text, no frame visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

avery-dna-heredity.description: A dark, warm oil-style still life of a laboratory bench. A glass Erlenmeyer flask of clear liquid holds faint white stringy threads. At upper right a hand holds a glass rod wound with white fibrous strands, lifting them above a small glass beaker. Another hand rests at the lower right. Behind are an old metal apparatus, amber glass bottles with worn labels, a lit candle, a rack of test tubes and petri dishes in the lower left. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

hershey-chase-experiment.description: A glass kitchen-style blender with a cloudy amber liquid sits on a dark laboratory bench. Beside it are a test tube rack holding a tube with a pale sediment, and a glass pipette. On the left, an open spiral notebook has small pencil sketches of angular, legged shapes that look like bacteriophages. A glass flask and a stand with tubing sit in the dim background. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square, with no frame or visible text.

human-46-chromosomes.description: An oil-painted laboratory scene in warm brown tones. A weathered, older hand holds a pale sheet with rows of dark, short rod-like marks, which look like chromosomes. Behind it stand a brass-and-black compound microscope and, on the wooden bench, a glass petri dish with cultured material, a small amber dropper bottle, and a clear glass jar. A corner shows forceps on a cloth. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or border.

genetic-code-cracked.description: A painted scene of a dim laboratory. A hand in a grey sleeve holds chalk at a large wooden-framed chalkboard covered in a grid of hand-drawn marks: dashes, dots, tally-like strokes and squiggles, with no legible letters. Strings of wooden and glass beads hang on the right edge. Glass flasks, tubing and stacked papers sit at the bottom. A single lamp lights the scene from above, in a dark, warm oil-painting style. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame.

first-restriction-enzyme.description: A pair of large metal scissors with ornate, knotted, curled handles cuts through a glowing double helix of DNA. The strand runs diagonally across a dark, painted laboratory with glassware, a test tube rack, an amber flask and a beaker on a wooden bench. Oil-painting style, warm light on the strand, dark brown background.

cohen-boyer-recombinant-dna.description: An oil painting in dark, warm tones. A large DNA double helix forms a ring across the middle, with one section splayed open at its ends and a thin, different-coloured strand threaded into the gap. Behind it are shelves of glass bottles and flasks, and in the foreground a petri dish of speckled colonies sits on a bench beside tweezers, a flask and an open notebook. No people are visible. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border.

he-jiankui-gene-edited-babies.description: A dark, painterly clinical room. A glass micropipette descends from the top into a petri dish holding a small, pale, curled human embryo or early fetus. Two empty stainless-steel bassinets with folded towels sit in the foreground. Wall monitors and an IV-style pole appear at the edges. No visible text, frame or border.

first-crispr-therapy-approved.description: An IV bag on a metal stand hangs over an empty reclining hospital chair in a dim room, its line running down toward the seat. On the right, against a dark red background, a crescent-shaped red blood cell sits beside a round, plump red cell. The painting is oil-like and fills the frame edge to edge. No people, no visible text.

mullis-invents-pcr.description: Dark interior view from inside an older car, with a three-spoke steering wheel bearing a star emblem, a lit dashboard with round gauges and a radio, looking out a windscreen at a winding forest road at night. Glowing double-helix DNA strands branch and multiply across the windscreen and the night scene above the road. No legible text.

custom-base-editing-infant.reason: Legible text is painted in: the vial reads 'Custom Base Editing' and the paper on the cart has the same heading. Paint the vial and papers without lettering.
custom-base-editing-infant.description: A dim painterly hospital room: a glass-sided crib under a warm lamp holding a teddy bear under blankets, an IV drip line beside it, monitors on the wall. On a cart at right is a small glowing vial labelled with words and papers showing a DNA helix and handwritten lettering. Fills the frame edge to edge.
